buildSteps.title: Gather training signal
buildSteps.detail: Assemble text, images, audio, code, recorded human demonstrations and logged interactions. Increasingly, agents also generate their own experience in simulated environments.

buildSteps.title: Pretrain a foundation model
buildSteps.detail: Train a large neural network on a self-supervised objective so it learns general patterns of language, perception and reasoning from raw data.

buildSteps.title: Post-train for instruction and reasoning
buildSteps.detail: Fine-tune on curated examples, then use feedback-based reinforcement learning to make the model follow goals, decompose tasks and show its working.

buildSteps.title: Give it memory and retrieval
buildSteps.detail: Add external stores the model can read and write, so it can recall past events and reuse solutions rather than restarting every time.

buildSteps.title: Wire up tools and actuators
buildSteps.detail: Expose APIs, code execution and, for embodied agents, motors and sensors — behind sandboxes and permission checks so mistakes stay contained.

buildSteps.title: Build the agent loop
buildSteps.detail: Run perceive → plan → act → observe repeatedly, with replanning when results differ from expectation and decomposition when a task is too large.

buildSteps.title: Train for long-horizon autonomy
buildSteps.detail: Use curricula, sparse-reward methods and self-play so the agent can stay coherent across thousands of steps rather than a few.

buildSteps.title: Add continual learning
buildSteps.detail: Let the agent absorb new skills after deployment without forgetting old ones — the hardest unsolved part of a genuinely general agent.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate, red-team and deploy gradually
buildSteps.detail: Measure capability across diverse tasks, probe failure and deception modes, and expand autonomy only where reliability is demonstrated.

prerequisites.why: general capability scales with training and inference compute; supply and energy are the constraints.
they handle broad tasks but remain unreliable over long horizons and on unfamiliar problems.
today a model is largely frozen after training; it does not reliably acquire new skills on its own.

prerequisites.tech: Robust world models for embodied action
prerequisites.why: physical tasks need prediction of real dynamics, where data is scarce and mistakes are costly.
benchmarks saturate or are gamed, so it is hard to state what an agent can and cannot do.
no proven way to guarantee that a system more capable than its operators pursues the intended goal.

pathway.milestone: tool-using agents that complete bounded software and knowledge tasks
pathway.unlocks: automation of narrow, checkable workflows under human review.

pathway.milestone: reliable multi-hour and multi-day agents with durable memory
pathway.unlocks: delegation of whole projects in software, research support and administration.

pathway.milestone: embodied agents that learn new physical skills on the job
pathway.unlocks: general-purpose robots in warehouses, farms and construction.

pathway.milestone: agents that continually learn and set their own subgoals under oversight
pathway.unlocks: broad autonomy across science and industry, with control and safety still unresolved.
